items.name: Breadth-first search
items.description: Breadth-first search.

items.name: Depth-first search
items.description: Depth-first search, including recursive traversal over graph or grid states.

items.name: Dijkstra
items.description: Dijkstra shortest path with non-negative edge weights.

items.name: Reachability
items.description: Compute or maintain which vertices or states are reachable under graph constraints.

items.name: Degree condition
items.description: Use vertex degrees or degree bounds to characterize, validate, or count graph structures.

items.name: Shortest-path update
items.description: Maintain shortest-path distances under added, removed, or restored edges.

items.name: Shortest-path DAG
items.description: Filter or orient edges that lie on shortest paths and reason on the resulting directed acyclic structure.

items.name: State expansion
items.description: Expand graph nodes with extra state dimensions.

items.name: Topological order
items.description: Process a DAG in topological order or use topological elimination for reachability, DP, or cycle detection.

items.name: DAG game DP
items.description: Compute winning and losing states on an acyclic directed game graph.

items.name: Bipartite coloring
items.description: Assign or maintain two-color parity constraints in a graph.

items.name: Strongly connected components
items.description: Contract directed strongly connected components and reason on the condensation DAG.

items.name: Bipartite matching
items.description: Find a maximum, perfect, or weighted matching in a bipartite graph, directly or through a flow reduction.

items.name: DAG path cover
items.description: Reduce a minimum path cover on a DAG to bipartite matching or maximum flow.

items.name: Maximum flow
items.description: Compute a maximum feasible flow in a capacitated network.

items.name: Minimum-cost flow
items.description: Send required flow while minimizing total edge cost, including weighted matching and circulation reductions.

items.name: Minimum cut
items.description: Use the source-side residual reachability or cut capacity after max flow.

items.name: Bridge detection
items.description: Find edges whose removal disconnects a graph or a relevant subgraph, often with DFS order and lowlink values.

items.name: Flow network modeling
items.description: Reduce constraints or choices to nodes, edges, capacities, and source/sink structure.

items.name: Bipartite independent set
items.description: Recover a maximum independent set in a bipartite graph via matching or min-cut duality.

items.name: Flow reconstruction
items.description: Convert saturated or positive-flow edges back into explicit decisions or output objects.

items.name: Spanning tree
items.description: Choose or use a spanning tree to define traversal labels, fundamental cycles, or connected structure.

items.name: Matrix-tree theorem
items.description: Count spanning trees or directed arborescences using Laplacian minors and the Matrix-Tree theorem.

items.name: Eulerian trail counting
items.description: Count Eulerian circuits or trails in a graph, including reductions using the BEST theorem.

items.name: Lowest common ancestor
items.description: Answer ancestor, path, or distance queries on a rooted tree using lowest common ancestors.

items.name: Euler tour
items.description: Flatten a rooted tree into entry/exit order so subtree or path relationships become interval operations.

items.name: Virtual tree
items.description: Compress marked tree vertices and their LCAs into an auxiliary tree preserving ancestor and path relationships.

items.name: Heavy-light decomposition
items.description: Decompose tree paths or recursive tree processing into heavy paths and light transitions.

items.name: Tree centroid
items.description: Find or use a tree centroid as a balanced separator without recursively decomposing the tree.

items.name: Centroid decomposition
items.description: Recursively decompose a tree by centroids so path or subtree contributions are counted at balanced separators.

items.name: Minimum spanning tree
items.description: Construct or reason about a minimum spanning tree.

items.name: Tree distance verification
items.description: Verify that a tree realizes required pairwise distances.

items.name: All-pairs tree distance
items.description: Compute or check distances between all pairs of vertices in a tree.
